newsitem.title: USA: Saba knows of no reason for stock activity. [CORRECTED 23:08 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Saba knows of no reason for stock activity. [CORRECTED 23:08 GMT]

text.p: Saba Petroleum Co said Thursday it knows of no reason for the unusual trading activity in its stock.

The company said in a statement it was unaware of any material change in its financial condition or operating prospects. Saba said its financial condition remains strong with sufficient cash flow from operations and bank lines of credit to support its current operations.
Shares of Saba were 6-1/8 lower at 12-3/4 on the American Stock Exchange.
